title: Frozen-snapshot successor for PAH-OMC-020 source-owned U_n evidence intake

fixed_scope.functional_and_rates: Exactly the PAH-001 functional and original directed PH/LK/AP/TR rates through the pinned OMC-018 chain; no refit, counterterm, averaging or rate change.
fixed_scope.finite_spaces: The original labelled finite G_n spaces, stationary laws and j-before-n order; no phase or charge direct-sum rescue.
fixed_scope.limit_hilbert_space: The single R-510 anchored H and R-512 minimal closed form at their pinned scope.
fixed_scope.comparison_maps: An owner packet must provide U_n into the fixed H with explicit domain, measure and norm control; a local coordinate pullback is not pre-admitted.
fixed_scope.time: The original external unaccelerated Markov time only; no quantum, proper or Lorentzian interpretation.

acceptance_conditions.owner_authority: Versioned authority, signer, provenance, non-post-hoc policy and SHA-256 are fixed before estimates.
acceptance_conditions.common_hilbert_realization: Every finite measurable space, measure, target H, domain and U_n property is explicit.
acceptance_conditions.local_cylinder_recovery: Every local cylinder has an explicit N(f) and the declared N1 norm/inner-product convergence.
acceptance_conditions.n2b_liminf: The PAH-specific arbitrary-sequence weak-liminf inequality is proved with topology and bounded-energy quantifiers.
acceptance_conditions.recovery_limsup: Every target-form vector has a compatible recovery sequence and limsup estimate.
acceptance_conditions.n2c_n4_boundary_escape: The unchanged unbounded rates satisfy compact-time boundary escape for every local cylinder.
acceptance_conditions.n2d_minimal_identification: The selected closed form is identified with the R-512 minimal closure.
acceptance_conditions.verification: Primary, non-importing independent, hostile and Lean manifests verify the model-specific packet.

required_owner_payload: packet_id, version, owner authority and SHA-256
measurable/probability realization of every finite space and the common H
explicit U_n (or equivalent) with domain, linearity and norm/inner-product control
N1 local-cylinder stabilization and recovery quantifiers
N2b arbitrary-sequence weak-liminf theorem with topology and bounded-energy quantifiers
compatible limsup/recovery sequence for every target-form vector
N2c/N4 compact-time boundary-escape estimate for the unchanged generator
N2d identification with the R-512 minimal closed form
primary, independent, hostile and Lean reproducibility manifests
forbidden_repairs: Changing PAH-001 functional, transition rates, mobility, state, carrier, regulator or limit order
Conditional Gibbs averaging, phasewise or cross-Q direct-sum selection, fitted density weights or post-hoc tuning
Treating a coordinate pullback as a completed-space map without a source estimate
Importing a generic convergence theorem without discharging its PAH-specific hypotheses
Replacing the R-512 minimal closure by a maximal or boundary-selected extension
Promoting the packet to Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang-Mills, continuum, mass-gap or TOE evidence

decision_rule.MAINLINE_ADVANCE: Admit only when every payload item is source-authorized, hash-pinned and all verification roles agree.
decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Use only for an exact counterexample inside unchanged PAH definitions.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: Use when any owner field, common-space estimate, boundary estimate, minimal identification or verification field is absent.

current_finding: The fixed snapshot reproduces the current candidate bytes and contains no source-authorized or complete owner packet. This successor repairs replay scope only; it does not define U_n.
single_next_question: Can one source-authorized owner provide all nine payload fields, including root multiplicity, a measure-compatible U_n, N2b liminf/recovery, N2c/N4 boundary escape and R-512 minimal identification, without changing PAH-001?
revisit_condition: Reopen after a versioned owner packet or a new candidate is detected; create a new snapshot whenever any parent or candidate byte changes.
non_claims: No source-authorized U_n/common-Hilbert realization, N2b liminf/recovery, N2c/N4 boundary escape, N2d minimal identification or PAH-OMC-020 semigroup convergence.
Snapshot absence is not a universal impossibility theorem and does not inspect future or external packets.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, mass-gap, Yang-Mills or TOE conclusion.
External Markov time remains stochastic bookkeeping and is not physical time.
